name: DCA Angry Dogs (Pixar Pier) "Slightly Annoyed Dog" All-Beef Hot Dog (Skip "Angry" Spicy Dog!)
brandOrRestaurant: Angry Dogs (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: The "Slightly Annoyed Dog" is a completely mild, skinless all-beef hot dog on a soft white bun served with plain potato chips—whereas the "Angry Dog" is a fiery spicy sausage with Flamin' Hot Fries.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Always order the **"Slightly Annoyed Dog"** (plain all-beef hot dog with plain Lay's chips) and never the spicy "Angry Dog".
watchOuts: Never order the spicy "Angry Dog" or "Keeping It Together" spicy condiments during flares
